scope: local structure, O6U identity/precuration, self-redocking, deterministic PLIP, and PyMOL figure QA

pymol.gui_launcher_prohibited_for_automation: PyMOLWin.exe detaches before ray-traced output completion and can create a false missing-output failure.

plip_native_structure.resolution: An isolated conda PLIP/Open Babel environment was used with explicit plugin and data directories. Two single-threaded no-reprotonation runs gave byte-identical text reports and identical canonically sorted O6U interaction records.

gromacs.disposition: Use the exact server environment only after environment and canary gates pass.

ffparam_qm.access_note: The official download requires a separate FFParam registration; CHARMM-GUI credentials were not reused or tested against that service.
ffparam_qm.disposition: Obtain the official licensed release, then perform CGenFF/FFParam targeted QM validation on a CPU-capable server before PDB Reader/Quick Bilayer approval.

secrets.note: CHARMM-GUI bearer material is stored outside the project with user-only ACL and is never written to audit records.
